Definition: from G2596 and G3306; to stay fully, i.e. reside:--abide.
BiblicalUsage: They went up into an upper room and abode there, the apostles waiting together after the ascension.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe waiting together in prayer is the first work of the church, and it came before any preaching.
